stories.subject: Mike Jones streaming resurgence after GTA VI soundtrack placement
stories.verification: Houston Chronicle and Axios both reported the renewed attention around Mike Jones and Houston rap following GTA VI's release; the 700% figure is explicitly attributed as reported rather than independently measured by either outlet.

stories.subject: Skepta credited across all four top positions on Official UK Rap Chart
stories.verification: The Official Charts page lists the Nov. 20–26 top four, and AllHipHop reports the sweep and track order.

stories.subject: GloRilla's Big Glo's 901 Turkey Drive in Memphis
stories.verification: Both reports identify the Nov. 24 Memphis turkey drive, Smackers Restaurant location, 3 p.m. opening and while-supplies-last status; the AOL report also carries WREG's interview context and the prior $25,000 school donation.

stories.subject: Second Circuit ruling in Mary J. Blige's Real Love copyright appeal
stories.verification: Music Business Worldwide and Bloomberg Law both report the Second Circuit's Nov. 23 affirmance of dismissal and the court's substantial-similarity reasoning.

stories.subject: Rockstar's first post-launch GTA VI patch for PS5 and Xbox
stories.verification: Rockstar's support notes list the fixes; IGN's syndicated patch report independently summarizes the same update and its seven fixes.

dedupe_note: Compared against the RapWire automation memory and the Nov. 22–23 batches; excluded the prior GTA VI launch-sales record, Don Toliver evacuation, Travis Scott crossover, Rockstar cut-activities angle and 2027 Grammy field.
